_readme: CBAM 快讯与 TRQ 追踪器同款。news = SMM 每周一更新的 CBAM 快讯（最新在上，中英一一对应，英文不得含中文）；cert = 欧委会季度证书价，由 GitHub Actions 每周一自动抓取，有新价时自动在 news 顶部加一条。手工改也可以，改完直接 push。

zh.t: SMM发布《一吨热卷进欧盟要交多少碳成本？》：按三季度价，印度热卷每吨约278欧元、中国约179欧元、日本约80欧元；本计算器已上架上海有色网「产业工具」与metal.com。
欧盟四季度钢铁配额10月1日开闸，一周内土耳其、中国大陆、印度等部分品类已用完，多为碳钢；印度热卷配额10月8日用尽，此后到港须缴50%配额外关税或顺延至一季度，CBAM另计。
更新节奏调整：快讯改为每周一更新（证书价公布、新法规生效等关键节点临时加更）；快讯条放慢，点「CBAM 快讯 ▾」可展开全部快讯。中文名称同步改为「钢铁 CBAM 计算器」。
CBAM下游扩围进入三方谈判：技术层会谈9月28日启动，首轮政治三方会谈定于10月20日，第二轮暂定11月30日，目标年内达成政治协议。本工具现有184个编码不受影响。
证书出售、回购与费用的授权法案由原定二季度推迟至四季度，而证书2027年2月1日开售，规则存在赶不上开售的风险；原产国已付碳价抵扣细则（第九条）5月草案仍未通过。
欧委会公布 2026 Q3 证书价 €82.32，较 Q2 的 €75.28 上涨 9.4%：中国热卷（7208）按默认值每吨 €178.63，比按 Q2 价多 €15.28；本计算器当天自动切换。Q4 价格 2027-01-04 公布，此前 Q4 时段按 €82.32 估算并标注。
默认时段改为当前季度：首次打开落在 2026 Q4，不再默认 Q1；未公布季度按最新官方价估算并标注。
熔铸国举证细则 IR 2026/1963 生效：附件 I 钢材报关须申报熔铸国与炉号，首选材质证明书（MTC），举证不足进口被拒。熔铸国现阶段不改变海关原产地，CBAM 默认值仍按原产国取。
默认值复核完成：5,993 个默认值与欧委会 8 月第 2 版数据文件逐条比对，0 差异；CSCF 依 CID 2026/1862 确认为 100%；方法论已对照欧委会指引 No. 4 / 5d。
欧委会完成CBAM豁免门槛评估：2025年4月至2026年3月，50吨门槛豁免的隐含排放占0.87%，低于1%上限，门槛维持50吨不变。
取向电工钢 GOES 临时保障措施生效至 2027-02-26：国别配额 + 价格门槛，7225 11 00 / 7226 11 00 在 CBAM 之外再叠一层；这两个编码不在钢铁 TRQ 范围内。
欧洲议会通过 CBAM 下游扩围立场：464 票赞成，扩至约 457 项产品并删除第 27a 条临时豁免；理事会立场约 380 项。三方谈判待开，本工具现有 184 个编码不受影响。
IR 2026/1740 更正 CBAM 默认值附录，追溯自 2026-01-01 适用；本工具数据已按此版逐值对齐。

en.t: SMM publishes “What does CBAM add to a tonne of HRC?”: at the Q3 price, Indian HRC carries about €278/t, Chinese €179/t and Japanese €80/t. The calculator is now listed under Industry Tools on smm.cn and Tools on metal.com.

Q4 EU steel quotas opened on 1 Oct; within a week some categories for Türkiye, Mainland China, India and others were used up, mostly carbon steel. India’s HRC quota ran out on 8 Oct, so later arrivals pay the 50% out-of-quota duty or wait for Q1; CBAM comes on top.

Update rhythm changed: news now refreshes every Monday, with extra updates on key dates such as certificate-price releases and new rules; the ticker runs slower — click “CBAM NEWS ▾” for the full list.

CBAM downstream extension moves to trilogue: technical talks began on 28 Sep, the first political trilogue is set for 20 Oct and a second provisionally for 30 Nov, aiming for a deal this year. The tool’s 184 codes are unaffected.

The delegated act on certificate sales, repurchase and fees has slipped from Q2 to Q4, while sales start on 1 Feb 2027, so the rules risk arriving late; the Article 9 rules on carbon prices paid abroad, drafted in May, are still not adopted.

Commission publishes the Q3 2026 certificate price at €82.32, up 9.4% from Q2’s €75.28: Chinese HRC (7208) on the default value now costs €178.63/t, €15.28 more than at the Q2 price; the calculator switched the same day. Q4 is published on 4 Jan 2027 and is estimated at €82.32 until then, labelled.
Default period now follows the calendar: first-time visitors land on 2026 Q4 instead of Q1; unpublished quarters use the latest official price, labelled as an estimate.

Melt-and-pour evidence rules (IR 2026/1963) apply: Annex I steel must declare the melt-and-pour country and heat number, ideally on the mill test certificate; imports without verifiable evidence are refused. Melt-and-pour does not change customs origin, so CBAM defaults still follow the country of origin.

Default-value audit done: all 5,993 values checked against the Commission’s August data file (version 2), zero differences; CSCF confirmed at 100% under CID 2026/1862; method checked against Commission guidance No. 4 and 5d.
Commission completes the CBAM de minimis assessment: for April 2025 to March 2026 the 50-tonne threshold exempts 0.87% of embedded emissions, below the 1% limit, so it stays at 50 tonnes.
Provisional safeguard on grain-oriented electrical steel in force to 26 Feb 2027: country quotas plus price thresholds; 7225 11 00 / 7226 11 00 carry it on top of CBAM and sit outside the steel TRQs.

European Parliament adopts its CBAM downstream-extension position, 464 in favour: about 457 products and Article 27a deleted; the Council’s position covers about 380. Trilogue pending; the tool’s 184 codes are unaffected.
IR 2026/1740 corrects the CBAM default-value annexes, retroactive to 1 Jan 2026; the tool is aligned to it value by value.
